narr: Thunderstorm activity over Elmore and Montgomery counties late on August 23 led to isolated flooding issues. Highway 14 west of Wetumpka had minor flooding after a couple inches of rain fell. Meanwhile, more extensive flooding took place around Meriwether Rd in Pike Road, with the roadway being closed after radar estimates of 4-5 of rain fell in the immediate area.
ev: Water was over the road along Highway 14 between Wetumpka and Elmore.
Meriwether Rd was reported as impassible via social media and was shut down by local law enforcement due to extensive flooding. The road was deemed impassible around midnight.
